verdict.rationale: Speechmatics' own diarization docs state the feature can separate a transcript into distinct speakers or channels, which directly covers keeping each side of a stereo or multichannel call separate. The evidence is a single summary line, so the depth of the capability is not shown. Missing for 10: detail on stereo/multichannel input handling and channel labeling in output, confirmation of batch vs real-time support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
